name: Jacek Protas - Proposition de résolution
title: REPORT on cohesion policy in the EU’s eastern border regions: strengthening territorial resilience and cross-border cooperation
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on the EU's eastern border regions – the areas next to Russia, Belarus, Ukraine and Moldova. It asks for extra money for these regions in the EU budget from 2028 to 2034, on top of what they already get. It also wants looser state aid rules, more help for cross-border projects, and money for security, transport, energy and keeping people from moving away. The report is an opinion; it does not change any law by itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks for extra funding and rule changes in the 2028–2034 budget.
- **Who it affects:** People and businesses in EU regions bordering Russia, Belarus, Ukraine, Moldova and the Black Sea.
- **What happens next:** Parliament sends its demands to the EU Commission and member states, which decide the next budget.
